annotations.title: Luxury Safari Planner: Where and When to Go

description: Ranks 11 well-known safari regions (Masai Mara, Serengeti, Okavango Delta, Greater Kruger and Sabi Sand, Madikwe, Eastern Cape, South Luangwa, Hwange, Etosha, Bwindi, Volcanoes) for a month of travel and priorities, using sourced best and rainy seasons and migration timing, and suggests a route with nights per camp. Wildlife timing varies year to year. No prices, availability, health or entry advice. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/safari-planner

family.description: Family with children under 15: favours malaria-free reserves and excludes gorilla treks (minimum age 15).

malariaFree.description: Malaria-free only: only regions widely described as malaria-free (not health advice).

nights.description: Nights in total, including any beach extension.

pace.description: relaxed ≈ 4, balanced ≈ 3, active ≈ 2 nights per camp (a planning choice).
